selection.name: cli/cli (C03)
selection.role: GitHub PR creation, editing, review, checks, merging and API automation through an agent-callable CLI.
selection.install_command: (type -p wget >/dev/null || (sudo apt update && sudo apt install wget -y)) && sudo mkdir -p -m 755 /etc/apt/keyrings && out=$(mktemp) && wget -nv -O$out https://cli.github.com/packages/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg && cat $out | sudo tee /etc/apt/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg > /dev/null && sudo chmod go+r /etc/apt/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg && sudo mkdir -p -m 755 /etc/apt/sources.list.d && echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg] https://cli.github.com/packages stable main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/github-cli.list > /dev/null && sudo apt update && sudo apt install gh -y

basis.shows: Documents GitHub CLI capabilities and an upstream agent skill. Inspected command source implements PR creation, editing and review.
Released 2026-09-30 with Linux amd64 and macOS arm64 packages and four security fixes. Repository is unarchived; latest trunk commit is also dated September 30.
Push/PR test infrastructure runs race-enabled unit/integration tests across Ubuntu, Windows and macOS. A successful relevant run was not qualified.
Hosted acceptance infrastructure uses disposable testing credentials across three platforms. Its presence does not establish a successful complete PR lifecycle evaluation.
Issue activity on 2026-10-01 establishes ongoing maintenance; the proposed feature is not treated as released capability.

layers.deciding_comparison: Compare Difftastic and sem on the same WSL2 and macOS arm64 corpus: internal edits, formatting, moves/renames, malformed syntax and large changes. Measure correctly exposed changes, misleading or missed changes, agent interpretation, latency and peak memory; determine whether both output forms justify installation. Separately qualify gh create/edit/review/check/merge/close against a disposable repository. Re-evaluate a changed codex-for-claude release using identical review fixtures; the inspected release remains v1.0.6.
evidence_gaps: No all-arm comparison was supplied, and no target-host execution was performed. Neither structural-diff repository has demonstrated measured superiority here.
Worktrunk and Difftastic successful CI samples concern PR commits, not the selected releases; workflow job details and test counts were not fetched.
gh test and acceptance infrastructure was verified from source, but no successful relevant lifecycle run was qualified.
sem current-source documentation is newer than v0.25.0. Its source install is documented, but current README features must not all be attributed to that binary release.
Recent issue activity was sampled for Worktrunk, gh and Difftastic; issue-resolution health for the remaining repositories was not qualified.
git/git releases/latest returned HTTP 404. claude-code-action’s rolling v1 release has a 2025 publication date despite current commits; neither fact establishes staleness.
Platform assets establish Linux x86_64 and macOS arm64 distribution support for the selected tools; WSL2 runtime compatibility remains untested. These roles require no GPU.
